meta.description: India NPK recommendations for 21 crops (22 records; barley split irrigated/rainfed) — user-supplied data (2026-10-13) with authentic Indian research sources (ICAR institutes, PAU, TNAU, CCSHAU, etc.). All per-acre values converted to per-hectare (×2.47105).

records.micronutrients: ZnSO4 (21%) 24.71 kg/ha (10 kg/acre) basal if zinc deficient.
records.applicationTiming: Basal at sowing; 1st split at CRI (20-25 DAS, 1st irrigation); 2nd split at tillering/jointing (40-45 DAS, 2nd irrigation).
records.applicationMethod: Apply 100% P2O5 and K2O alongside 1/3 N at sowing (basal dose). Apply 1/3 N at Crown Root Initiation (CRI) stage during 1st irrigation (20-25 days after sowing). Apply remaining 1/3 N during 2nd irrigation at tillering/jointing stage (40-45 days after sowing).
records.notes: N 48-50 kg/acre (~2.2 bags urea); P2O5 20-24 kg/acre (~1 bag DAP); K2O 15-16 kg/acre (25-30 kg MOP).
records.source_org: ICAR - Indian Institute of Wheat and Barley Research (IIWBR), Karnal

records.micronutrients: ZnSO4 (21%) 24.71 kg/ha (10 kg/acre) broadcast at final puddling to counter Khaira disease.
records.applicationTiming: Basal at final puddling; N top-dress at active tillering (21 DAT); remaining N + 50% K at panicle initiation.
records.applicationMethod: Apply all P2O5, 50% K2O and 1/3 N as basal during final puddling before transplanting. Top-dress 1/3 N at active tillering (21 days after transplanting). Top-dress remaining 1/3 N and 50% K2O at panicle initiation (PI) stage.
records.notes: N 48-52 kg/acre (~2.2 bags urea); P2O5 20-24 kg/acre (~1 bag DAP); K2O 16-20 kg/acre (27-33 kg MOP). Transplanted high-yielding paddy.
records.source_org: ICAR - National Rice Research Institute (NRRI), Cuttack

records.applicationTiming: Basal band at planting; N top-dress at V6 knee-high (25-30 DAE); final N at tasseling/silking initiation.
records.applicationMethod: Band-place all P2O5, K2O and 1/3 N at planting. Top-dress 1/3 N at knee-high stage (V6, 25-30 days after emergence). Top-dress remaining 1/3 N at tasseling/silking initiation.
records.notes: N 48-60 kg/acre (~2.2-2.6 bags urea); P2O5 24-28 kg/acre (~1-1.2 bags DAP); K2O 20-24 kg/acre (33-40 kg MOP). Hybrid maize.
records.source_org: ICAR - Indian Institute of Maize Research (IIMR), Ludhiana
records.source_org_2: Choudhary Charan Singh Haryana Agricultural University (CCSHAU), Hisar

records.micronutrients: MgSO4 24.71 kg/ha (10 kg/acre) + Borax 4.94 kg/ha (2 kg/acre), foliar or basal — prevents leaf reddening and square drop.
records.applicationTiming: Basal P + 50% K at sowing; N split across squaring, early flowering, boll formation with remaining K2O.
records.applicationMethod: Apply all P2O5 and 50% K2O at field preparation/sowing. Split N into 3-4 applications at squaring, early flowering and boll formation stages along with remaining K2O.
records.notes: N 48-60 kg/acre (~2.2-2.6 bags urea); P2O5 24-30 kg/acre (~1-1.3 bags DAP); K2O 24-30 kg/acre (40-50 kg MOP). Bt hybrid, irrigated.
records.source_org: ICAR - Central Institute for Cotton Research (CICR), Nagpur
records.source_org_2: Professor Jayashankar Telangana State Agricultural University (PJTSAU)

records.applicationTiming: Basal P + 1/3 K at planting; N in equal splits at 45, 90, 120 DAP with earthing up. No N after 150 days.
records.applicationMethod: Place full P2O5 and 1/3 K2O at planting in furrows below the setts. Apply nitrogen in equal splits at 45, 90 and 120 days after planting (with earthing up). Avoid N after 150 days to safeguard sucrose accumulation.
records.notes: N 90-110 kg/acre (~4-5 bags urea); P2O5 28-35 kg/acre (~1.2-1.5 bags DAP); K2O 30-40 kg/acre (50-65 kg MOP). Plant crop.
records.source_org: ICAR - Indian Institute of Sugarcane Research (IISR), Lucknow

records.micronutrients: Sulphur 19.77-24.71 kg/ha (8-10 kg/acre) via SSP or elemental sulphur.
records.applicationTiming: All basal drilled at sowing.
records.applicationMethod: Apply 100% NPK and sulphur as basal drill application at sowing. Treat seeds with Bradyrhizobium japonicum and PSB (Phosphate Solubilizing Bacteria).
records.notes: N 8-12 kg/acre (starter); P2O5 24-32 kg/acre (~1-1.4 bags DAP/SSP); K2O 12-16 kg/acre (20-27 kg MOP).
records.source_org: ICAR - Indian Institute of Soybean Research (IISR), Indore

records.micronutrients: Gypsum 395.37-494.21 kg/ha (160-200 kg/acre) — critical at pegging.
records.applicationTiming: NPK basal before sowing; gypsum split — 50% basal, 50% at 40-45 DAS (pegging).
records.applicationMethod: Incorporate basal NPK before sowing (SSP preferred for P). Apply gypsum close to root zone at peg penetration (50% basal + 50% at 40-45 days after sowing) to prevent shell popping.
records.notes: N 8-10 kg/acre; P2O5 16-20 kg/acre (SSP preferred); K2O 15-20 kg/acre.
records.source_org: ICAR - Directorate of Groundnut Research (DGR), Junagadh

records.micronutrients: Sulphur 19.77-29.65 kg/ha (8-12 kg/acre) via bentonite sulphur or SSP.
records.applicationTiming: Full P, K, S + 50% N at sowing; remaining N at first irrigation (~30 DAS, flowering initiation).
records.applicationMethod: Apply full P, K, S and 50% N at sowing. Apply remaining 50% N at first irrigation (flowering initiation, ~30 days after sowing).
records.notes: N 32-40 kg/acre (~1.5-1.8 bags urea); P2O5 16-20 kg/acre; K2O 12-16 kg/acre. Indian mustard (Brassica juncea).
records.source_org: ICAR - Directorate of Rapeseed-Mustard Research (DRMR), Bharatpur

records.micronutrients: Borax 4.94 kg/ha (2 kg/acre), foliar or soil applied — for seed set filling.
records.applicationTiming: Full P, K + 50% N at sowing; remaining N at bud stage (30-35 DAS).
records.applicationMethod: Apply 100% P and K and 50% N at sowing. Top-dress 50% N at button/bud stage (30-35 days after sowing).
records.notes: N 24-32 kg/acre; P2O5 24-30 kg/acre; K2O 12-16 kg/acre.
records.source_org: ICAR - Indian Institute of Oilseeds Research (IIOR), Hyderabad

records.applicationTiming: Full P, K + 50% N at sowing; remaining N at 25-30 DAS pre-flowering.
records.applicationMethod: Apply full P and K and 50% N at sowing. Top-dress remaining N at 25-30 days after sowing, before flowering.
records.notes: N 12-16 kg/acre; P2O5 10-12 kg/acre; K2O 10-12 kg/acre. Til.
records.source_org: ICAR - All India Coordinated Research Project on Sesame and Niger, Jabalpur

records.applicationTiming: All basal banded 4-5 cm below seed line at sowing.
records.applicationMethod: Apply all fertilizers as basal band placement 4-5 cm below the seed line.
records.notes: N 8-10 kg/acre (starter); P2O5 16-20 kg/acre; K2O 8-10 kg/acre. Masoor.
records.source_org: ICAR - Indian Institute of Pulses Research (IIPR), Kanpur

records.applicationTiming: All at sowing via ferti-seed drill.
records.applicationMethod: Apply entire dose at sowing using a ferti-seed drill.
records.notes: N 8-10 kg/acre; P2O5 20-24 kg/acre; K2O 8-12 kg/acre. Gram.
records.source_org: ICAR - Indian Institute of Pulses Research (IIPR), Kanpur

records.applicationTiming: All deep-banded at sowing.
records.applicationMethod: Deep band placement at sowing.
records.notes: N 8-12 kg/acre; P2O5 20-25 kg/acre; K2O 10-12 kg/acre. Tur/Arhar.
records.source_org: ICAR - Indian Institute of Pulses Research (IIPR), Kanpur

records.applicationTiming: Basal at sowing; foliar 2% DAP at pre-flowering and pod setting.
records.applicationMethod: Basal placement at sowing. Foliar spray of 2% DAP at pre-flowering and pod setting.
records.notes: N 8-10 kg/acre; P2O5 16-20 kg/acre; K2O 8-10 kg/acre. Green gram.
records.source_org: ICAR - Indian Institute of Pulses Research (IIPR), Kanpur

records.applicationTiming: 50% N + full P, K at sowing; remaining N at 1st irrigation.
records.applicationMethod: Irrigated: 50% N + full P and K at sowing; remaining 50% N at 1st irrigation.
records.notes: N 24-30 kg/acre (irrigated); P2O5 12-16 kg/acre; K2O 8-10 kg/acre.
records.source_org: ICAR - Indian Institute of Wheat and Barley Research (IIWBR), Karnal

records.applicationTiming: All basal at sowing (rainfed).
records.applicationMethod: Rainfed: all fertilizer basal at sowing.
records.notes: N 12-16 kg/acre (rainfed); P2O5 12-16 kg/acre; K2O 8-10 kg/acre.
records.source_org: ICAR - Indian Institute of Wheat and Barley Research (IIWBR), Karnal

records.applicationTiming: Full P, K + 50% N at planting; remaining N at 30-35 DAE.
records.applicationMethod: Full P, K and 50% N at planting; 50% N top-dressed at 30-35 days after emergence.
records.notes: N 32-40 kg/acre; P2O5 16-20 kg/acre; K2O 16-20 kg/acre. Jowar.
records.source_org: ICAR - Indian Institute of Millets Research (IIMR), Hyderabad

records.applicationTiming: 50% N + full P, K at sowing; remaining N at 3-4 weeks (thinning/interculture).
records.applicationMethod: 50% N and 100% P & K at sowing; remaining 50% N at thinning/interculture (3-4 weeks after sowing).
records.notes: N 24-32 kg/acre; P2O5 12-16 kg/acre; K2O 10-12 kg/acre. Bajra.
records.source_org: ICAR - Indian Institute of Millets Research (IIMR), Hyderabad

records.applicationTiming: 50% N + full P, K at transplanting/sowing; remaining N 3 weeks later.
records.applicationMethod: 50% N and all P and K at transplanting/sowing; 50% N top-dressed 3 weeks later.
records.notes: N 20-24 kg/acre; P2O5 16-20 kg/acre; K2O 10-12 kg/acre. Ragi.
records.source_org: ICAR - All India Coordinated Research Project on Small Millets, UAS Bangalore

records.applicationTiming: Full P, K + 1/3 N at sowing; 1/3 N at 20-25 days (1st weeding); 1/3 N at 40-45 days.
records.applicationMethod: Apply 100% P and K and 1/3 N at sowing. Top-dress 1/3 N at 20-25 days (first weeding) and 1/3 N at 40-45 days.
records.notes: N 24-32 kg/acre; P2O5 12-16 kg/acre; K2O 12-16 kg/acre. Tossa/white jute.
records.source_org: ICAR - Central Research Institute for Jute and Allied Fibres (CRIJAF), Barrackpore

records.applicationTiming: Full P, K + 50% N at planting; remaining N at first earthing up (30-35 DAP).
records.applicationMethod: Apply full P, K and 50% N at furrow preparation/planting. Apply remaining 50% N at first earthing up (30-35 days after planting).
records.notes: N 60-72 kg/acre (~2.7-3.2 bags urea); P2O5 32-40 kg/acre (~1.4-1.8 bags DAP); K2O 40-50 kg/acre (65-85 kg SOP/MOP).
records.source_org: ICAR - Central Potato Research Institute (CPRI), Shimla

records.micronutrients: Sulphur 29.65-37.07 kg/ha (12-15 kg/acre) — essential for pungency, allyl propyl disulfide formation and storage quality.
records.applicationTiming: Full P, K, S + 1/3 N at transplanting; N top-dressed at 30 and 45 DAT. Stop N 30 days before harvest.
records.applicationMethod: Apply full P, K, S and 1/3 N at field preparation/transplanting. Split remaining N into two top-dressings at 30 and 45 days after transplanting. Stop N at least 30 days before harvest.
records.notes: N 40-50 kg/acre; P2O5 20-24 kg/acre; K2O 24-32 kg/acre.
records.source_org: ICAR - Directorate of Onion and Garlic Research (DOGR), Rajgurunagar, Pune
